Italy 1–1 England in the UEFA Euro (2020) — a draw. Italy produced 19 shots worth 2.04 xG; England managed 6 shots worth 0.49 xG.

Goals: Luke Shaw (England, 1′, xG 0.15); Leonardo Bonucci (Italy, 66′, xG 0.80).

It went all the way: after extra time, the shootout finished Italy 3–2 England.

The biggest chance that got away: Ciro Immobile (Italy) with a 0.15-xG opportunity in the 45′ that ended blocked.

On the balance of chances, Italy edged the underlying numbers by 1.55 xG.
